title: statutory-offences-of-causing-death-by-driving-sentencing-guideline.pdf — section 7
text:
1 Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 section 35C. This applies to determinate sentences (sentences for a fixed length of
time). When a life sentence is imposed, the period of disqualification which the court would otherwise have imposed
must be extended by a period equal to the punishment part of the life sentence.
